## How it works

Minecraft chat is limited to users one the same world or the same server. Awooing connects you to an external chat-server, that lets you send messages wherever you want!

## Download and Installation

Head over to the [Releases page](https://github.com/Awoooly/awooing/releases), choose your Minecraft version, and download the `.jar` file from that release's assets.

Install it like any other Fabric mod by following the [Fabric Installing Mods guide](https://docs.fabricmc.net/players/installing-mods). This mod requires the [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).  

## Commands

**Connection**
- `/awoo connect` - Connect to the Awooing-Server  
- `/awoo disconnect` - Disconnect from the Awooing-Server  
- `/awoo autoconnect` - Toggle auto-connect (true by default)


**Messaging**
- `/a <message>` - Send a single message to the Awoo-Chat  
- `/chat awoo` - Toggle the Awoo-Chat-mode  
- `/amsg <user> <message>` - Send a private message
- `/ar <message>` - Reply to a private message

**Rooms**
- `/awoo join <room> [password]` - Join a room  
- `/awoo list [room]` - List connected users  
- `/awoo create <name> [public|private] [pw]` - Create a room  
- `/awoo leave [room]` - Leave a room  

**Hosting** (requires leading a room)
- `/awoo roomprivacy <room> <pub|priv> [pw]` - Change your room’s privacy settings  
- `/awoo invite <user> [room]` - Invite a user to your room  
- `/awoo kick <user> [room]` - Kick a user from your room  
- `/awoo host <user> [room]` - Transfer your room host rights to someone else  

**Utility**
- `/awoo publicrooms [page]` — List public rooms  
- `/awoo emojis` — List available emojis  
- `/awoo color [color]` — Show or change your chat color  
- `/awoo status` — Print connection, room, and version status  
- `/awoo changeip <IP> [Port]` — Update the saved server address  

</details>

## Security and Privacy

**Secure Connection**: All connections between client and server are protected using TLS/SSL encryption, ensuring that data is transmitted securely.

**Privacy**: Awooing does not store or log personal messages or chat content. Limited, non-personal metrics (such as current user count and active room count) are collected solely for service operation and monitoring. This data is aggregated and does not allow identification of individual users or their communication.

**Authentication**: Authentication is handled through Minecraft’s built-in server join flow via Mojang. Awooing does not receive or store login credentials. A Minecraft account is required to use Awooing.
